copy.headline: Battle Cats Global 15.4
copy.shortIntro: Global 15.4 brings the big Speed Up change, 13th Anniversary content, Fate collaboration additions, new forms, talents, stages, and text/name updates.

sections.title: Release Status
sections.summary: Japanese release: May 25, 2026. International release: June 10, 2026.

sections.title: Speed Up and Early Game
sections.summary: Infinite Speed Up and 3x Speed Up moved out of Gold Membership and became available to all players. Gold members now use Gold Cat CPUs for only 1 Cat CPU, and the old 30-day Beginner Daily Bonus was replaced with a 7-day version after beating Japan in Empire of Cats Chapter 1.

items.name: Infinite Speed Up for all players
Gold Cat CPU battle skips cost 1 Cat CPU

sections.title: New Cats
sections.summary: Five units were added, with CRO ids 861 through 865, including Dragon Emperors, June Bride, and Fate collaboration units.

sections.title: New Form
sections.summary: Narita Kaihime received an Ultra Form with higher HP, range, speed, Savage Blow chance, Explosion, and Sage Slayer.

sections.title: Talents and Ultra Talents
sections.summary: Saber, Sakura Matou, and Mighty Carrowsell received Talents. Sharpshooter Saki received Ultra Talents, including Target Dark, Strengthen, and Explosion Immunity.

sections.title: New Enemy
sections.summary: True Assassin was added as a new enemy.

sections.title: Stages
sections.summary: The update adds New Horizon in Zero Legends, Fate collaboration stages, True Assassin Assault, Abyssal stages, Otherworld Colosseum and Ranking Dojo content, plus 2-crown additions and many reward/energy/XP adjustments.

items.name: Abyssal: Bottom of the Swamp and Prelude to Evil
Otherworld Colosseum and Ranking Dojo updates

sections.title: Cat Combo
sections.summary: One combo was added for Massive Damage effect support.

sections.title: Text, Rewards, and Anniversary Content
sections.summary: Global also receives 13th Anniversary content from JP 15.0, new User Rank rewards, several Ancient Egg plus-level cap increases, rewritten story openings/endings, description updates, and name changes such as Legend Cats becoming Mythic Cats.

items.name: Legend Cats renamed to Mythic Cats
